CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Handball: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Handball.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Handball.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Handball.

2. Best practice when working on Javelin and Sculpture: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Javelin and Sculpture.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Javelin and Sculpture.
   D. Damage equipment used for Javelin and Sculpture.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Guarantee a trophy

4. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.

5. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   B. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   D. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

7. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

9. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.

10. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

11. Best practice when working on Storytelling and Animation: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Storytelling and Animation.
   B. Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Storytelling and Animation.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Storytelling and Animation.

12. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Indigenous Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. A — Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. B — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

4. A — Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. D — Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. D — The speed of the music

7. D — Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. B — Red, blue, and yellow

9. B — Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. C — Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. B — Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. D — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Swimming; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan Indigenous Games; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Rhythm; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
